title: Prism
tagline: An inclusive platform for LGBTQ+ community leveraging web3.
description:
The LGBTQ+ community face a lot of challenges in the existing system. The non-inclusivity and harrasment they face are unparalleled. Prism is an inclusive platform tailored for the LGBTQ+ community. The features are focused on solving their pain points. We have a blogs feature where community members can post and share without the fear of judgement or harrasment. The members often don't know who to ask their doubts to, so we have a QnA section where they can resolve their queries with the help of other community members. Many companies open up job oppurtunities specifically for the community, but the members don't often get to know about them. So we have a jobs portal for the same. In our society, the community members are often considered as outcasts, they find it hard to get inclusive housing. So we have a housing feature to show inclusive accomodation options. We also have a feature to connect with community-specialized therapists.
